pages.brief: Pip on a fence rail looking up at a huge green oak in full summer leaf, the tree filling most of the page. Fresh, wet greens.
pages.alt: Pip stands on a fence rail looking up at a huge green oak tree in full summer leaf, which fills most of the page in fresh, wet greens.

pages.brief: Close on a single wet leaf high in the oak with a small round beetle on it, its shell shining. Rain-fresh green.
pages.note: b382 fix — the bush-only composition read as 'a bush and an unclear shape'. Now the oak canopy fills the background (trunk cropped off below the frame so only foliage shows, selling 'high in the oak') with one big leaf_single in front and the beetle sitting on it.
pages.alt: A close view of a single wet leaf high in the oak, the canopy filling the background, with a small round beetle sitting on the leaf, its shell shining.

pages.brief: Night scene, seen through a rain-streaked view: the oak dark against a deep blue sky, rain falling in long silver lines. No characters. Atmospheric.
pages.alt: A night scene with the oak dark against a deep blue sky and rain falling in long silver lines across the whole picture.

pages.brief: Morning after. A goat standing patiently in the field beside the oak, rain still dripping from the branches onto its back.
pages.alt: A goat stands patiently in the field beside the oak the morning after the rain, with drips still falling from the branches onto its back.

pages.brief: Close on the goat's soaked coat, fur parted into wet points, water beading and running. It looks resigned. Gently funny.
pages.alt: A close view of the goat's soaked coat, fur parted into wet points with water beading and running, looking thoroughly resigned.

pages.brief: Pip on a branch looking down at Ned in a small wooden boat on the pond below. Aerial viewpoint so we see the boat from above — a deliberately wide, distant view down onto the pond.
pages.alt: Pip looks down from a branch at Ned in a small wooden boat on the pond far below, seen from above.

pages.brief: Ned in the boat with a leaf hoisted as a sail, steering with great concentration towards the reader. The wind is filling the leaf.
pages.alt: Ned sails his little boat with a leaf hoisted as a sail, steering with great concentration as the wind fills it.

pages.brief: Close low view over the side of the boat: Ned's orange webbed feet, clearly visible through the clear shallow water, paddling away. Funny and sweet.
pages.alt: A close, low view shows Ned's orange webbed feet clearly paddling through the clear shallow water beside his boat.

pages.brief: Closing page: Pip and Ned side by side on the upturned boat on the bank, both dripping wet, a rainbow over the oak behind them. Bright and joyful.
pages.alt: Pip and Ned sit side by side on the upturned boat on the bank, both dripping wet, with a bright rainbow over the oak behind them.
